description: This Rust source file defines a custom error type 'NiceDatabaseError' for handling SQL database errors, including functions for displaying errors with source code highlighting, and methods for formatting error messages related to SQL query execution.

classes.name: NiceDatabaseError
classes.description: A custom error type for representing detailed database errors, including source file, error details, query string, and optional query position.

methods.name: fmt
methods.description: Implements Display trait to format the NiceDatabaseError as a human-readable string with optional source code highlighting.

methods.name: show_position_info
methods.description: Displays the position of the query in the source file if available.
